name: Targa Resources
description: Targa collects natural gas from producers (mainly in the Permian Basin), processes it into dry gas and a raw mix of natural gas liquids (NGLs), then moves, splits (fractionates), stores and exports those NGLs from Mont Belvieu and the Gulf Coast. Most revenue comes from fees per unit of volume, but it also keeps some NGLs and gas as payment under certain contracts and sells them, so reported revenue is large and swings with commodity prices while the margin is much more stable. FY2025 revenue was $17,028.3M but product purchases and fuel cost $10,507.8M of that.

employees.note: Approximately 3,570 people, employed through a wholly-owned subsidiary; none covered by collective bargaining.

businessLines.name: Gathering and Processing
businessLines.how: Producers pay per unit to have their gas gathered, treated and processed (mostly fee-based), plus some contracts where Targa keeps NGLs or gas as payment and sells them at market prices, partly hedged.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 segment operating margin (adjusted operating margin $3,346.2M before $907.0M operating expenses)

businessLines.name: Logistics and Transportation (Downstream)
businessLines.how: Fee-based pipeline transport, fractionation, storage, terminaling and export of NGLs under take-or-pay-style and volume contracts, plus marketing margins from buying and reselling NGLs and propane.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 segment operating margin (adjusted operating margin $3,182.0M before $393.7M operating expenses)

brands.name: Targa Badlands LLC
brands.note: Targa bought Blackstone 45% interest in March 2025 for $1.8 billion cash, taking full ownership (Badlands, Williston Basin).
